title: Kill or die
description: A recreation of the datapack used in NewKiddo’s “Kill or die” series
body:
# Kill or die
> **You MUST be playing in hardcore mode.**

In this datapack, one heart is removed from your health bar every 10s. The only way to gain them back is by killing mobs. How far can you make it ?

_Multiplayer may be supported, but has not been tested yet._
